title: On Choosing the longer road on purpose
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：choose　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 choose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the painter ① chose the longer road on purpose twice over, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② chooses the longer road on purpose year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ choose the longer road on purpose at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ chosen the longer road on purpose before — a line in the catalogue for May 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Choosing the longer road on purpose twice over, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ choose to stay behind alone year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Choose to stay behind alone at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ chooses to stay behind alone twice over every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ chose the longer road on purpose again when nobody else would.

⑩ To choose the longer road on purpose, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody chooses the longer road on purpose year after year again and somebody must choose the longer road on purpose twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 选择（一般过去式 chose the longer road on purpose：1951 年画师头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 选择（一般现在 chooses the longer road on purpose：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 选择（不定式 to choose the longer road on purpose：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 选择（过去完成时 had chosen the longer road on purpose：1945 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 选择（动名词 choosing the longer road on purpose 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 情愿（choose to stay behind alone：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去情愿情愿独自留下）
G. v. 情愿（choose to stay behind alone：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 选择（后段两处：新来的观者照例 chooses to stay behind alone，而母亲又一次 chose the longer road on purpose）

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，画师来回两遍选择特意挑那条远路；画室里每一个观者都说这是头一回。（chose the longer road on purpose）
多年以后，画师仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（chooses the longer road on purpose）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯选择特意挑那条远路这件事本身。（to choose the longer road on purpose）
早在 1945 年就有人选择特意挑那条远路，五月那天展品目录上的一行字就是证据。（had chosen the longer road on purpose）
画师说过，来回两遍选择特意挑那条远路这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（choosing the longer road on purpose 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻情愿情愿独自留下，以后再也不要提起。（choose to stay behind alone，祈使句）

Somebody had chosen the longer road on purpose long before 1958, and the line in the catalogue for May proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 choose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the painter chose the longer road on purpose twice over, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter chooses the longer road on purpose year after year whenever the studio asks.
Choosing the longer road on purpose twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever choose to stay behind alone year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio chooses to stay behind alone twice over every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother chose the longer road on purpose again, and the studio remembered that half.
